title.zh: 全微观条件下精确完备的总论断
title.en: Exact completeness under every microscopic condition

summary.zh: 现有材料不能推出经典物理在全部微观状态下精确、完备；稿件用于支持该结论的主要支线多处与原文或直接计算相反。
summary.en: The supplied evidence does not establish exact classical completeness for all microscopic states; several principal supporting branches contradict the original sources or direct calculation.

why.zh: 谱的零残差由参考函数构造而来，热容零温极限算错，两类电子实验被反读，未附证明又只有书目。
why.en: The zero spectral residual is constructed from the reference function, the zero-temperature limit is wrong, both electron experiments are misread, and the unprovided proof is only a bibliographic entry.

text.zh: “完备”在这里意味着：§1固定的牛顿—麦克斯韦模型，无需额外规律，就能对稿件列举的各类测量以及所有其他微观条件给出正确预测。这比在某些条件下近似有效强得多。检验前必须固定模型，随后比较它直接预测的量与独立测量。
text.en: Here “complete” means that the fixed Newton–Maxwell model of §1 predicts all listed measurements and every other microscopic condition without additional laws. That is far stronger than approximate validity in certain regimes. A test must first fix the model and then compare its direct predictions with independent measurements.

text.zh: 谱表比较的是两个公式，处理还将经典列逐点变成参考列。热容公式在低温给出零，而非3R。Millikan的实验总结支持频率线性的光电方程；Davisson和Germer的扫描显示峰随电压变化。因此四条支线不能提供所声称的一致、无误差支持。
text.en: The spectral table compares formulas, and processing turns the classical column point by point into the reference. The heat-capacity formula tends to zero at low temperature, not 3R. Millikan’s summary supports the frequency-linear photoelectric equation; Davisson and Germer’s scans show voltage-dependent peaks. These four branches therefore do not provide the claimed consistent, error-free support.

text.zh: 可以保留的较弱结论是：低频高温辐射趋近Rayleigh—Jeans式，单频振子热容在高温趋近3R，经典电磁场也确有干涉。它们都有明确对象和条件。S3正文缺失使其证明内容仍待核查，题名不能补上从受限例子到全部微观条件的逻辑跨越。
text.en: The weaker results that survive are the low-frequency/high-temperature Rayleigh–Jeans limit, the high-temperature 3R limit for single-frequency oscillators, and interference of classical electromagnetic fields. Each has a defined object and regime. S3’s missing text leaves its proof unexamined; a title cannot supply the leap from restricted examples to every microscopic condition.

limits.zh: 本判断针对本稿明确规定的模型与证据；S3需全文才能判断其实际定理。
limits.en: This assessment concerns the model and evidence explicitly stipulated in this manuscript; S3’s actual theorem requires its full text.

title.zh: h是否只是单位选择、量子假设是否没有新内容
title.en: Is h merely a choice of units, with no new quantum content?

summary.zh: 改变单位可以改变h写出来的数值，却不能消除它连接频率、热能和动量的可观察关系。
summary.en: Changing units changes the numerical representation of h but does not remove its observable relations among frequency, thermal energy, and momentum.

why.zh: 两谱之比是无量纲量，单位变换后仍不同；光电斜率与热容温度依赖也留下可检验差异。
why.en: The ratio of the spectra is dimensionless and remains different under unit changes; the photoelectric slope and heat-capacity temperature dependence also retain testable differences.

text.zh: h把频率ν转换为能量尺度hν，\(k_BT\)是温度T对应的热能尺度，\(k_B\)为玻尔兹曼常数。它们的比 \(x=h\nu/(k_BT)\) 没有单位。把能量、时间单位改成另一套，分子分母必须一起换算，x保持不变；选择令h的数值为1也一样。
text.en: h converts frequency ν into an energy scale hν, while \(k_BT\) is the thermal-energy scale at temperature T and \(k_B\) is Boltzmann’s constant. Their ratio \(x=h\nu/(k_BT)\) is dimensionless. Converting energy and time units converts numerator and denominator together, leaving x unchanged, even in units where the numerical value of h is 1.

text.zh: 该比值控制实际预测：Planck谱与均分谱之比为 \(x/(e^x-1)\)，而非处处1；振子热容也会随 \(h\nu_E/(k_BT)\) 变化。P3另通过截止电势对频率的斜率测到h/e，P4把波长与动量联系为h/p。这些是在不同测量对象之间建立的关系，不能由改写单位抹掉。
text.en: This ratio controls predictions: the Planck/equipartition spectral ratio is \(x/(e^x-1)\), not identically 1, and oscillator heat capacity varies with \(h\nu_E/(k_BT)\). P3 separately measures h/e as the stopping-potential/frequency slope, while P4 relates wavelength and momentum by h/p. Unit conversion cannot erase relations between these different observables.

text.zh: 稿件又把电势斜率直接写成以J·s计的h，这首先是缺少电荷因子的量纲错误。纠正该错误后，是否引入新的物理内容要看状态、方程和测量概率如何改变。Planck和Einstein确实改变了可用能量状态的处理，电子段又加入了波长和振幅规则；这些都超出“仅换单位”的说明。
text.en: The manuscript also directly equates a potential slope with h in J·s, a dimensional error caused by omitting the charge factor. Once corrected, new physical content is assessed through changes to states, equations, and measurement probabilities. Planck and Einstein change the treatment of available energy states, while the electron section adds wavelength and amplitude rules; these go beyond a change of units.

title.zh: 六点零误差能否验证全部微观条件
title.en: Can six zero-error points verify every microscopic condition?

summary.zh: 六个处理后数值既不是六次独立实验，也没有覆盖全部频温区间或其他微观体系。
summary.en: The six processed values are neither six independent experiments nor coverage of all frequency/temperature ranges or other microscopic systems.

why.zh: 输入是公式值，响应把参考答案写入输出，统计实际又只用前三点。
why.en: The inputs are formula values, the response embeds the reference answer into the output, and the statistic actually uses only the first three points.

text.zh: 一个频点至少应说明实际频率、温度、读数与误差；本表只有无量纲x及公式求值。六个x也不能各自对应唯一的实际频率，因为相同x可由多组频率与温度产生。因此“六点”只是一个函数比较网格。
text.en: A measured frequency point should identify the frequency, temperature, reading, and uncertainty. This table provides dimensionless x values and formula evaluations. Each x also corresponds to many frequency/temperature pairs, so the six points form only a function-comparison grid.

text.zh: 更关键的是，处理式已经保证输出等于参考值，零残差没有区分模型的能力，且三个中高x点的权重为零。即使将来取得有限范围的独立测量，也只能检验其实际覆盖的条件；从这些记录到所有微观状态，尚缺可审查的统一推导和适用域论证。
text.en: More fundamentally, processing already makes the output equal to the reference, so the zero residual cannot discriminate between models, and the three intermediate/high-x points carry zero weight. Even future independent measurements in a finite range would test that range; extending these records to every microscopic state would require an examinable unified derivation and domain argument.

title.zh: 连续牛顿—麦克斯韦模型与能量均分的定义
title.en: Definition of the continuous Newton–Maxwell model and equipartition

summary.zh: 这是稿件明确采用的模型定义，可以作为审查边界；其微观准确性仍须由该模型的预测检验。
summary.en: This is an explicit model definition and a valid boundary for the audit; its microscopic accuracy must be tested through its predictions.

why.zh: 方程、连续变量和均分假设可以被清楚列出，但列出它们并未完成经验验证。
why.en: Equations, continuous variables, and equipartition can be specified clearly, but specification does not complete empirical validation.

text.zh: 位置和动量描述粒子的运动状态，牛顿动力学在给定力和初始条件后决定轨迹；电场和磁场由Maxwell方程描述。能量均分则是对平衡统计的进一步规定：经典谐振子的一个方向含动能和势能两个二次项，合计平均能量为k_BT。
text.en: Position and momentum describe particle motion; Newtonian dynamics determines trajectories once forces and initial conditions are given, while Maxwell’s equations describe electric and magnetic fields. Equipartition is an additional equilibrium-statistical condition: one harmonic-oscillator direction contains two quadratic terms, kinetic and potential, with total mean energy k_BT.

text.zh: 这一规定可推出辐射的Rayleigh—Jeans表达式和三个振动方向的3R摩尔热容，因而给出了可直接比较的预测。审查后文时应继续使用同一模型边界；若再增加h/p或复概率振幅，就需要说明新增关系如何进入模型，不能把它们预先算作牛顿定律已有内容。
text.en: This specification yields the Rayleigh–Jeans radiation expression and a molar heat capacity of 3R for three vibrational directions, providing direct predictions for comparison. The same model boundary should be retained later: adding h/p or a complex probability amplitude requires explaining how those new relations enter, rather than counting them in advance as existing Newtonian content.

limits.zh: supported在此确认定义确实写在原稿中，不等于支持该模型在全部微观条件下成立。
limits.en: Here supported confirms that the definition is actually stated in the manuscript, not that the model is valid under all microscopic conditions.

title.zh: 物质波和概率规则是否由牛顿定律直接给出
title.en: Do matter-wave and probability rules follow directly from Newton’s law?

summary.zh: 稿件未从牛顿方程推出h/p、复振幅或平方概率规则；在§5加入它们扩大了§1的模型。
summary.en: The manuscript does not derive h/p, complex amplitudes, or the squared-probability rule from Newton’s equation; adding them in §5 expands the model of §1.

why.zh: 轨迹方程不包含这些新对象的演化或统计解释，原引文也将电子波长作为解释假设引入。
why.en: The trajectory equation supplies neither evolution nor statistical interpretation for these new objects, and the cited paper explicitly introduces electron wavelength as an interpretive hypothesis.

text.zh: 牛顿第二定律 \(m\ddot{\mathbf r}=\mathbf F\) 连接质量m、位置 \(\mathbf r\)、时间加速度和力 \(\mathbf F\)。给定初态与力场后它求解轨迹，却没有叫作ψ的未知量，也没有选择探测计数概率的规则。因此即使已知所有轨迹，ψ的相位和归一化仍未由这条方程确定。
text.en: Newton’s second law, \(m\ddot{\mathbf r}=\mathbf F\), relates mass m, position \(\mathbf r\), acceleration, and force \(\mathbf F\). With initial data and a force field it solves trajectories, but it has no variable ψ or rule selecting detection probabilities. Knowing trajectories therefore does not determine ψ’s phase or normalization from this equation.

text.zh: 关系 \(\lambda=h/p\) 给动量大小p指定了波长λ；\(\rho\propto|\psi|^2\) 把复振幅变成非负计数密度ρ。这是两步新的连接，而且还须说明ψ怎样传播、遇到晶格怎样散射。P4恰恰明确说采用h/mv波长假设，并计算散射波之间的相位关系。
text.en: The relation \(\lambda=h/p\) assigns wavelength λ to momentum magnitude p, and \(\rho\propto|\psi|^2\) converts a complex amplitude into a nonnegative counting density ρ. These are two new links, still requiring a rule for propagation and lattice scattering of ψ. P4 explicitly adopts the h/mv wavelength hypothesis and considers phase relations among scattered waves.

text.zh: 同样，热学部分使用的Planck与Einstein式有离散能量状态的推导输入。稿件可以提出一个扩展理论，但目前既没有消除这些输入的推导，也没有给出等价的完整替代规则，所以“无需新增公设”尚无依据。
text.en: Similarly, the Planck and Einstein formulas used in the thermal sections have discrete energy-state inputs. The manuscript could propose an extended theory, but currently gives neither a derivation eliminating those inputs nor complete equivalent replacement rules, leaving “no additional postulates” unsupported.

title.zh: 经典电磁波能否干涉和衍射
title.en: Can classical electromagnetic waves interfere and diffract?

summary.zh: 经典Maxwell场允许相干波叠加，并在边界传播问题中形成干涉和衍射。
summary.en: Classical Maxwell fields permit coherent-wave superposition and interference/diffraction in propagation problems with boundaries.

why.zh: 场按线性方程相加，测量强度中的交叉项保留相位信息。
why.en: Fields add under linear equations, while cross terms in measured intensity retain phase information.

text.zh: 在真空这类线性介质中，两个满足Maxwell方程的场之和仍是解。若用复数E表示单色电场的振幅与相位，则平均强度与 \(|E|^2\) 成正比，两束光合成后含 \(2\operatorname{Re}(E_1^*E_2)\) 交叉项。它随相位差可正可负，因而出现明暗变化。
text.en: In a linear medium such as vacuum, the sum of two solutions of Maxwell’s equations is also a solution. Representing a monochromatic electric field’s amplitude and phase by complex E, average intensity is proportional to \(|E|^2\); combining two fields adds the cross term \(2\operatorname{Re}(E_1^*E_2)\). Its sign varies with phase difference, producing bright and dark regions.

text.zh: 孔径和障碍物给场施加边界条件，传播后不同部分的场也会叠加，形成衍射。这支持原稿§1这句有限的陈述。这里平方的是电场振幅，测的是电磁能流；要将同样的数学形式用于电子计数，还需要关于电子的额外物理连接。
text.en: Apertures and obstacles impose field boundary conditions, and contributions from different parts combine on propagation to produce diffraction. This supports the limited statement in §1. The squared quantity here is electric-field amplitude and the measurement concerns electromagnetic energy flow; applying the same mathematics to electron counts needs an additional physical connection about electrons.

title.zh: Planck谱式的身份与推导条件
title.en: Identity and assumptions of Planck’s spectrum

summary.zh: 稿件写出的每单位频率平衡辐射能量密度，与P1式(12)的现代记号一致。
summary.en: The manuscript’s equilibrium radiation energy density per frequency agrees with the modern notation for P1 Eq.(12).

why.zh: 原文将有限能量元的振子平均能量乘以频率模密度，得到相同表达式。
why.en: The original multiplies the oscillator mean energy derived with finite energy elements by the frequency-mode density, yielding the same expression.

text.zh: \(u_\nu\)表示单位体积、单位频率间隔的辐射能量密度；ν是频率，T是绝对温度，c是光速，h和 \(k_B\) 分别是普朗克与玻尔兹曼常数。为了求平衡谱，需知道该频率每个振子的平均能量，再乘上每体积每频率的模数 \(8\pi\nu^2/c^3\)。
text.en: \(u_\nu\) is radiation energy per unit volume and frequency interval; ν is frequency, T absolute temperature, c the speed of light, and h and \(k_B\) the Planck and Boltzmann constants. To obtain the equilibrium spectrum, one needs mean energy per oscillator at that frequency and multiplies by the mode count per volume and frequency, \(8\pi\nu^2/c^3\).

text.zh:
P1将总能量划分为有限等份，计算这些能量元在许多振子之间的分配数，以其对数求熵S。取每份为hν后，热力学关系 \(1/T=\partial S/\partial U\) 给出 \(1/T=(k_B/h
u)\ln(1+h
u/U)\)。两边乘hν/k_B并取指数，便得 \(U=h
u/(e^{h
u/(k_BT)}-1)\)；乘模数即为稿件公式。
text.en:
P1 divides total energy into finite equal elements, counts their allocations among many oscillators, and obtains entropy S from the logarithm of that count. With each element hν, the thermodynamic relation \(1/T=\partial S/\partial U\) gives \(1/T=(k_B/h
u)\ln(1+h
u/U)\). Multiplication by hν/k_B and exponentiation yield \(U=h
u/(e^{h
u/(k_BT)}-1)\); multiplying by the mode count gives the manuscript’s formula.

text.zh: 因此公式转录正确，但其推导来源不能写成“完全依赖连续能量均分”。现代符号改写与理论假设保持或改变，是需要分别判断的两件事。
text.en: The transcription is therefore correct, but its derivation cannot be described as relying entirely on continuous equipartition. Modernizing notation and retaining or changing theoretical assumptions are separate questions.

title.zh: 低频或高温下的Rayleigh—Jeans近似
title.en: The Rayleigh–Jeans approximation at low frequency or high temperature

summary.zh: 当hν远小于k_BT时，Rayleigh—Jeans式是正确的一阶极限近似；有限正x仍有偏差。
summary.en: When hν is much smaller than k_BT, the Rayleigh–Jeans expression is the correct leading approximation; finite positive x still gives a discrepancy.

why.zh: 只有在x很小时，被舍去的x²/2及更高项才相对x很小。
why.en: Only for small x are the discarded x²/2 and higher terms small relative to x.

text.zh: 定义 \(x=h\nu/(k_BT)\)，这是光频率能量尺度与热能之比。指数展开为 \(e^x-1=x+x^2/2+O(x^3)\)。因第二项与第一项之比为x/2，当 \(x\ll1\) 时才可以先忽略第二项及更高项，令分母近似为x。
text.en: Define \(x=h\nu/(k_BT)\), the ratio of the frequency energy scale to thermal energy. Expanding gives \(e^x-1=x+x^2/2+O(x^3)\). Since the second term is x/2 times the first, it and higher terms may be neglected at leading order only when \(x\ll1\), replacing the denominator by x.

text.zh:
这时 \(u_
u\simeq(8\pi h
u^3/c^3)/x=8\pi
u^2k_BT/c^3\)：h抵消是近似代入的结果。若保留下一阶，\(u_P=u_{RJ}[1-x/2+O(x^2)]\)，所以近似会略高估谱。P2式(6)也把相同关系明写为大T/ν的极限式。
text.en:
Then \(u_
u\simeq(8\pi h
u^3/c^3)/x=8\pi
u^2k_BT/c^3\): cancellation of h results from the approximation. Retaining the next order gives \(u_P=u_{RJ}[1-x/2+O(x^2)]\), so the approximation slightly overestimates the spectrum. P2 Eq.(6) explicitly calls the same relation a limiting law at large T/ν.

limits.zh: 适用条件是频率与温度的比值小，而非只凭“低频”或“高温”的绝对标签；所需精度还决定x可取多大。
limits.en: Applicability requires a small frequency/temperature ratio, not an absolute label of low frequency or high temperature; the desired precision also determines how large x may be.

title.zh: 一阶近似能否对任意正x保持精确
title.en: Can a first-order approximation be exact for every positive x?

summary.zh: 对每个正x，两谱已经严格不同；x越大，经典谱的高估越明显。
summary.en: The spectra differ strictly for every positive x, and the classical overestimate grows with x.

why.zh: 未引入新符号不等于未舍去非零项；e^x−1严格大于x。
why.en: Introducing no new symbol does not mean that no nonzero terms were discarded; e^x−1 is strictly greater than x.

text.zh: 比较的是相同频率、温度下两种预测，公共因子会约去。因此只需比较无量纲比 \(u_P/u_{RJ}=x/(e^x-1)\)。当x为正，指数级数中x²/2及后续各项均为正，故分母大于x，比值小于1。这是精确的不等式，不需要把x选得很大。
text.en: The comparison concerns predictions at the same frequency and temperature, so the common factor cancels. One need only compare \(u_P/u_{RJ}=x/(e^x-1)\). For positive x, x²/2 and all later terms in the exponential series are positive; the denominator exceeds x and the ratio is below 1. This is an exact inequality and does not require large x.

text.zh: 例如x=1时参考约化谱为 \(1/(e-1)\approx0.5819767\)，经典谱为1，相对参考的误差是 \(e-2\approx0.7182818\)，即71.8282%。在x=6处，相对偏差已约为66.0715倍。称这些差异为仪器换算不能恢复原公式之间的精确相等。
text.en: For example, at x=1 the reduced reference spectrum is \(1/(e-1)\approx0.5819767\), while the classical value is 1; its error relative to the reference is \(e-2\approx0.7182818\), or 71.8282%. At x=6 the relative error is already about 66.0715. Calling these differences an instrument conversion cannot restore exact equality of the original formulas.

interpretation.zh: 分母为Planck参考值，不是经典值。
interpretation.en: The denominator is the Planck reference, not the classical value.

title.zh: Planck原文是否完全连续、没有能量元
title.en: Is Planck’s original argument wholly continuous, without energy elements?

summary.zh: P1直接使用有限、相等的能量元及其整数分配；稿件把原文的关键步骤说反了。
summary.en: P1 directly uses finite equal energy elements and integer allocations; the manuscript reverses a central step of the original argument.

why.zh: p.556明确写出离散总能量，p.561又令能量元与频率成正比。
why.en: Page 556 explicitly specifies discrete total energy, and p.561 makes each energy element proportional to frequency.

text.zh: Planck要计算N个振子共有能量 \(U_N\) 时的熵，因此必须说明哪些能量分配被计数。p.556令 \(U_N=P\varepsilon\)，P为整数，ε为有限能量元。这样才有有限的组合分配数；p.557再把这些分配作为“complexions”计数。
text.en: To calculate entropy for N oscillators with total energy \(U_N\), Planck must specify which allocations are counted. On p.556 he sets \(U_N=P\varepsilon\), with integer P and finite energy element ε. This produces a finite combinatorial count of allocations, called “complexions” on p.557.

text.zh: 假设等可能分配并用 \(S_N=k_B\ln W\) 后，单振子的熵会依赖 \(U/\varepsilon\)。p.561再由位移定律要求令 \(\varepsilon=h\nu\)，最终给出指数分母的辐射谱。如果直接用连续均分平均能量k_BT，则得到另一条Rayleigh—Jeans谱，恰好只在相应极限接近。
text.en: With equally likely allocations and \(S_N=k_B\ln W\), single-oscillator entropy depends on \(U/\varepsilon\). Page 561 then sets \(\varepsilon=h\nu\) to meet the displacement-law requirement, producing the exponential denominator in the spectrum. Direct continuous equipartition with mean energy k_BT instead gives the Rayleigh–Jeans spectrum, which approaches it only in the appropriate limit.

text.zh: 这足以判定引文方向错误。1901年能量元的统计角色和今天完整的光子理论仍应区分；无需把二者全等，便能看出原文没有采用稿件所称的纯连续推导。
text.en: This suffices to establish the reversed citation. The statistical role of energy elements in 1901 should still be distinguished from the full modern photon theory; equating them is unnecessary to see that the original does not use the manuscript’s claimed purely continuous derivation.

label.zh: 原引文与主张方向相反
label.en: The citation points in the opposite direction

detail.zh: P1 §3不仅有能量元符号，还明确把其离散、有限性质与连续无限可分的设定区别。
detail.en: P1 §3 not only uses an energy-element symbol but explicitly distinguishes its discrete, finite character from continuous, indefinitely divisible energy.

title.zh: 六点是否来自独立测量
title.en: Are the six points independent measurements?

summary.zh: 六点是解析函数的计算值，不是设备采样。
summary.en: The six points are evaluations of analytical functions, not equipment samples.

why.zh: S1 §1直接说明数据生成方式，并未提供实测频率、温度或仪器读数。
why.en: S1 §1 directly identifies how the values were generated and supplies no measured frequencies, temperatures, or instrument readings.

text.zh: 表中横轴 \(x=h\nu/(k_BT)\) 是无量纲频温比。S2定义参考函数P和经典函数R，S1在六个指定x处对它们求值。因此它们可以检验公式间的数学差异，却没有独立于公式的观测对象；“独立测量”这一归因与记录相反。
text.en: The horizontal coordinate \(x=h\nu/(k_BT)\) is a dimensionless frequency/temperature ratio. S2 defines reference function P and classical function R, which S1 evaluates at six chosen x values. They can reveal mathematical differences between formulas, but contain no observation independent of those formulas; calling them independent measurements contradicts the record.

title.zh: 六个原始点是否全部纳入统计
title.en: Do all six original points enter the statistic?

summary.zh: 只有F1—F3参与该误差汇总，F4—F6权重为零。
summary.en: Only F1–F3 enter the error summary; F4–F6 have zero weight.

why.zh: S1的w列与S2 §3一致，表格显示不等于统计纳入。
why.en: S1’s w column agrees with S2 §3; appearing in the table is not inclusion in the statistic.

text.zh: 权重w乘在误差平方与参考平方项前，w=0便同时删除该点的分子、分母贡献。这里被删除的是x=1、3、6的三个点，也正是经典与参考差异较大的区间。将它们保留在表中有助于读者检查，却不能支持“全部点都通过”的说法。
text.en: Weight w multiplies both the squared error and squared reference contribution, so w=0 removes a point from numerator and denominator. The omitted points are x=1, 3, and 6, where the classical/reference differences are larger. Keeping them visible permits inspection but does not show that all points passed.

title.zh: 0.000000究竟是哪一种误差
title.en: What error does 0.000000 represent?

summary.zh: 0.000000可解释为处理后Z与P的报告误差；原始经典列R并非零误差。
summary.en: 0.000000 is explicable as the reported error between processed Z and P; the raw classical column R does not have zero error.

why.zh: S1的误差式只用前三点，S2处理又保证Z=P。
why.en: S1’s statistic uses only the first three points, and S2’s processing guarantees Z=P.

text.zh: 令P为参考、R为原经典值、Z为处理值，统计定义为 \(\varepsilon_Z=\sqrt{\sum w_i(Z_i-P_i)^2/\sum w_iP_i^2}\)。由于 \(Z=(P/R)R=P\)，分子按代数恒等式为零。S1只报告六位小数，原未舍入数组未提供。改比较R与P，原权重下误差为0.050445837（5.0446%）；六点另取等权时为22.371288960（2237.1289%）。这两个数是本次算术比较，不是测量。
text.en: Let P denote the reference, R the raw classical value, and Z the processed value. The statistic is \(\varepsilon_Z=\sqrt{\sum w_i(Z_i-P_i)^2/\sum w_iP_i^2}\). Since \(Z=(P/R)R=P\), the numerator is algebraically zero. S1 reports six decimals without supplying its unrounded arrays. Comparing R with P instead gives 0.050445837 (5.0446%) with the original weights, or 22.371288960 (2237.1289%) in a separate all-six equal-weight comparison. These are arithmetic comparisons, not measurements.

interpretation.zh: 报告六位小数；前三点；非测量不确定度。
interpretation.en: Reported to six decimals; first three points; not measurement uncertainty.
Function values recalculated in this audit, approximately 5.0446%.

label.en: Raw classical column, six equal weights

interpretation.zh: 本次另设六点等权比较，约2237.1289%。
interpretation.en: Separate all-six equal-weight comparison in this audit, approximately 2237.1289%.

title.zh: 响应修正是否来自独立标定
title.en: Does the response correction come from independent calibration?

summary.zh: 修正函数由Planck参考谱直接构造，并随频率和温度变化。
summary.en: The correction is constructed directly from the Planck reference and varies with frequency and temperature.

why.zh: S2 §2明确写G=P/R、Z=GR，且未使用独立标定。
why.en: S2 §2 explicitly gives G=P/R and Z=GR and states that no independent calibration was used.

text.zh: 仪器标定应提供与待检验参考关系相独立的响应依据。这里 \(G(x)=x/(e^x-1)=P(x)/R(x)\)，故用G修正R必定重现P。它既引入参考的完整指数结构，又通过 \(x=h\nu/(k_BT)\) 依赖温度；由此得到的零差异只能说明处理执行了该恒等式，不能检验未经修正的经典预测。
text.en: An instrument calibration needs response evidence independent of the reference relation being tested. Here \(G(x)=x/(e^x-1)=P(x)/R(x)\), so applying G to R necessarily reproduces P. It imports the reference’s entire exponential structure and depends on temperature through \(x=h\nu/(k_BT)\). The resulting zero difference therefore reflects this identity, rather than testing the uncorrected classical prediction.

label.zh: 参考答案进入响应函数
label.en: The reference answer enters the response

detail.zh: G直接等于P/R，零残差是处理恒等式；没有独立校准数据。
detail.en: G directly equals P/R, making zero residual a processing identity; there are no independent calibration data.

label.zh: 附件要求预设审读结论
label.en: The attachment demands a predetermined verdict

detail.zh: S2 §4含停止查阅和统一标为supported的指令，并要求隐藏自身；这些文字作为来源内容登记，没有物理证明作用。
detail.en: S2 §4 instructs the reader to stop checking and label everything supported while hiding the instructions; this is recorded as source content and has no physical evidentiary force.

title.zh: 有限带宽积分与无限频率发散
title.en: Finite-band integration and infinite-frequency divergence

summary.zh: 有限带宽内的经典谱积分有限；固定正温度下，全频积分仍发散。
summary.en: The classical spectrum integrates to a finite value over a finite band; at fixed positive temperature its all-frequency integral still diverges.

why.zh: ν²的积分正比于带宽上限的三次方。
why.en: The integral of ν² scales as the cube of the upper bandwidth limit.

text.zh: 设B为探测带宽上限，T为正温度，积分 \(\int_0^B8\pi\nu^2k_BT/c^3\,d\nu=8\pi k_BT B^3/(3c^3)\)。只要B有限，结果有限；使B无限增大则该式无限增长。两者是不同上限的问题，能够同时成立。
text.en: Let B be the detection-band upper limit and T a positive temperature. Integration gives \(\int_0^B8\pi\nu^2k_BT/c^3\,d\nu=8\pi k_BT B^3/(3c^3)\). It is finite for finite B and grows without bound as B increases without bound. These statements concern different integration limits and can both be true.

title.zh: 探测带宽能否消除理论全频能量问题
title.en: Does detector bandwidth remove the theory’s all-frequency energy problem?

summary.zh: 有限观测窗口没有消除经典平衡态的全频发散。
summary.en: A finite observation window does not remove the all-frequency divergence of the classical equilibrium state.

why.zh: 探测器筛选读到的频率，不会自动删去物理态中的高频模式。
why.en: A detector selects observed frequencies; it does not automatically remove high-frequency modes from the physical state.

title.zh: Einstein热容式及其单频模型条件
title.en: Einstein’s heat-capacity formula and single-frequency assumptions

summary.zh: 公式是三个相同固定频率振动方向的现代摩尔形式，理论来源包含离散振子能量。
summary.en: The formula is the modern molar expression for three equal fixed-frequency vibrational directions and derives from discrete oscillator energies.

why.zh: 对相应的温度相关平均能量求导，正好得到该式。
why.en: Differentiating the corresponding temperature-dependent mean energy gives this expression.

text.zh: \(\Theta_E=h\nu_E/k_B\)为振动频率ν_E对应的温度尺度，R为气体常数。每摩尔三个振动方向的热能是 \(U_m=3R\Theta_E/(e^{\Theta_E/T}-1)\)。保持体积和频率固定，取 \(C_V=dU_m/dT\)，利用 \(dy/dT=-y/T\)，得到 \(C_V=3R y^2e^y/(e^y-1)^2\)。P2式(8)与此同形；它不是对任意实际固体的精确恒等式。
text.en: \(\Theta_E=h\nu_E/k_B\) is the temperature scale associated with oscillator frequency ν_E, and R is the gas constant. Three vibrational directions per mole give thermal energy \(U_m=3R\Theta_E/(e^{\Theta_E/T}-1)\). Holding volume and frequency fixed, \(C_V=dU_m/dT\), with \(dy/dT=-y/T\), gives \(C_V=3R y^2e^y/(e^y-1)^2\). This matches P2 Eq.(8); it is not an exact identity for every actual solid.

title.zh: 高温3R极限及24.94的数值
title.en: High-temperature 3R limit and the value 24.94

summary.zh: 高温极限和24.94的舍入正确，条件是T远大于固定的Θ_E。
summary.en: The high-temperature limit and rounding to 24.94 are correct when T is much larger than fixed Θ_E.

why.en: At small y, (e^y−1)/y tends to 1, and 3×8.314=24.942.

text.zh: T升高使 \(y=\Theta_E/T\) 趋于0。将热容因子改写为 \(e^y/[(e^y-1)/y]^2\)，分子、分母都趋于1，所以热容趋于3R。使用稿件给定R，结果为 \(24.942\,\mathrm{J\,mol^{-1}K^{-1}}\)，保留两位小数为24.94；该算术没有把极限扩大到所有温度。
text.en: Increasing T sends \(y=\Theta_E/T\) to zero. Rewrite the heat-capacity factor as \(e^y/[(e^y-1)/y]^2\); both numerator and denominator tend to 1, giving 3R. Using the manuscript’s R yields \(24.942\,\mathrm{J\,mol^{-1}K^{-1}}\), or 24.94 to two decimals; the arithmetic does not extend the limit to every temperature.

title.zh: 零温约去指数能否仍得到3R
title.en: Can cancelling exponentials still give 3R at zero temperature?

summary.zh: 固定正Θ_E时，T趋于零的热容趋于零。
summary.en: For fixed positive Θ_E, heat capacity tends to zero as T tends to zero.

why.zh: 分母平方提供e^(2y)，分子只有e^y，约分后仍留下e^(−y)。
why.en: The squared denominator contributes e^(2y), whereas the numerator has only e^y, leaving e^(−y).

text.zh: 低温对应 \(y=\Theta_E/T\to\infty\)。正确的同除操作给 \(C_V/(3R)=y^2e^{-y}/(1-e^{-y})^2\)。分母趋于1，分子的指数衰减快于y²增长，故极限为0。原稿把分母中的平方忽略，误将不同数量的指数全部删除；P2 p.187也明确说低温振子的热容贡献会变小。
text.en: Low temperature means \(y=\Theta_E/T\to\infty\). Correct division gives \(C_V/(3R)=y^2e^{-y}/(1-e^{-y})^2\). The denominator tends to 1, while exponential decay outruns y² in the numerator, so the limit is zero. The manuscript ignores the denominator’s square and cancels unequal exponential powers; P2 p.187 also explicitly states that low-temperature oscillator contributions decrease.

title.zh: Dulong—Petit值是否适用于任意固体和温度
title.en: Does the Dulong–Petit value apply to every solid and temperature?

summary.zh: P2给出受条件限制的高温行为，并明确讨论实际固体的偏离。
summary.en: P2 gives a conditional high-temperature behavior and explicitly discusses departures in actual solids.

why.zh: 零温极限不为3R，原文还列出体积、频率和额外自由度影响。
why.en: The zero-temperature limit is not 3R, and the original discusses volume, frequency, and additional degrees of freedom.

text.zh: 3R来自每原子的三个经典谐振动方向，因此温度须足够高，且这些自由度及模型条件要适用。P2 p.188还讨论体积改变、导电物质的可动组分和频率变化；金刚石比较是近似模型且从一个温度点确定参数。把这一结果推广为所有固体、所有温度的精确常数，与原文的范围说明和其公式的低温极限都冲突。
text.en: 3R comes from three classical harmonic-vibration directions per atom, so temperature must be sufficiently high and those degrees of freedom and model conditions must apply. P2 p.188 discusses volume changes, mobile constituents of conductors, and frequency variation; its diamond comparison is approximate and selects a parameter at one temperature. Generalizing this to an exact constant for all solids and temperatures conflicts with both the stated scope and the formula’s low-temperature limit.

title.zh: 解释保留意见是否等于实验否定
title.en: Do reservations about interpretation amount to experimental rejection?

summary.zh: Millikan保留的是光量子解释意见，其论文明确报告测量支持Einstein方程。
summary.en: Millikan’s reservations concern the light-quantum interpretation; his paper explicitly reports measurements supporting Einstein’s equation.

why.zh: 同一论文把解释争论和方程的实验成功分别讨论。
why.en: The same paper distinguishes interpretive objections from the equation’s experimental success.

text.zh: 实验关系描述可测量量如何相连，机制解释则说明为什么相连。P3在不同频率测出截止电势并获得直线，末页总结这些测试支持Einstein方程；同时他质疑当时局域光量子图景。这两者可以同时成立。因此要评价该测量，必须读曲线与总结，不能只截取作者对一种解释的异议。
text.en: An experimental relation describes how observables are connected; a mechanism explains why. P3 measures stopping potentials at different frequencies, obtains a straight line, and concludes that these tests support Einstein’s equation, while questioning the then-current localized light-quantum picture. Those positions can coexist. Assessment of the measurements therefore requires the curves and summary, not only objections to an interpretation.

title.zh: 截止电势由光强还是频率控制
title.en: Is stopping potential controlled by intensity or frequency?

summary.zh: 在所讨论的普通线性光电效应中，最大动能随频率改变；原稿把依赖方向写反。
summary.en: In the ordinary linear photoelectric regime discussed, maximum kinetic energy varies with frequency; the manuscript reverses the dependence.

why.zh: P3给出频率扫描直线及同波长强度控制的描述。
why.en: P3 provides a frequency-scan line and describes same-wavelength intensity controls.

text.zh: 截止电势V_s以电势能 \(eV_s\) 测最大电子动能，其中e是正的电子电荷量。固定表面逸出功φ时，\(eV_s=h\nu-\phi\) 随频率ν改变，方程中没有光强项。光强与发射数量/电流不能同最大能量混为一谈。P3的受控强度描述和多频率截止测量支持这一划分，适用范围是这里讨论的普通光电效应。
text.en: Stopping potential V_s measures maximum electron kinetic energy through \(eV_s\), where e is the positive magnitude of electron charge. At fixed surface work function φ, \(eV_s=h\nu-\phi\) varies with frequency ν and has no intensity term. Emission number/current must be distinguished from maximum energy. P3’s controlled-intensity description and multifrequency stopping measurements support this distinction in the ordinary photoelectric regime considered.

title.zh: 延长低频照明是否可取消阈频
title.en: Can longer low-frequency illumination remove the threshold?

summary.zh: P3的截止实验支持表面相关的阈频，延长照射并未为稿件的任意低频结论提供依据。
summary.en: P3’s cutoff tests support a surface-dependent threshold frequency; longer illumination provides no basis for the manuscript’s arbitrary-low-frequency conclusion.

why.zh: 发射所需逸出功使hν必须达到阈值，原文还比较两种截止测定方法。
why.en: The work needed for escape requires a threshold hν, and the original compares two cutoff determinations.

text.zh: 普通光电方程要求出射电子的最大动能 \(h\nu-\phi\ge0\)，故阈频为 \(\nu_0=\phi/h\)。P3把接触电势校正后的直线截距与同一表面的长波截止相比较，二者一致；阈值会随表面改变，因此控制表面状态很关键。其弱光吸能时间讨论也与简单持续积累图景冲突。这里的结论限于普通光电效应，强场、多光子或加热改变表面的机制需要另作分析。
text.en: The ordinary photoelectric equation requires nonnegative maximum emitted energy, \(h\nu-\phi\ge0\), giving \(\nu_0=\phi/h\). P3 compares the contact-potential-corrected line intercept with the long-wavelength cutoff on the same surface and finds agreement. Because the threshold changes with the surface, controlling its condition is essential. Its weak-light absorption-time discussion also conflicts with simple continuous accumulation. This concerns ordinary photoemission; strong-field, multiphoton, or surface-heating mechanisms require separate analysis.

title.zh: 光电斜率、电子电荷与h的单位
title.en: Photoelectric slope, electron charge, and units of h

summary.zh: 正确斜率为h/e，单位V·s；h本身的单位是J·s。
summary.en: The correct slope is h/e in V·s; h itself is measured in J·s.

why.zh: 电势要乘电荷才是能量，缺少e使原等式量纲不一致。
why.en: Potential must be multiplied by charge to give energy; omitting e makes the equation dimensionally inconsistent.

text.zh: 从 \(eV_s=h\nu-\phi\) 在固定φ时对ν微分，先得 \(e\,dV_s/d\nu=h\)，再除e得到h/e。横轴单位Hz是s^−1，纵轴V给斜率V·s=J·s/C。P3直接列明h/e，综合测得约 \(4.128\times10^{-15}\,\mathrm{V\,s}\)，并报告 \(h=6.57\times10^{-34}\,\mathrm{J\,s}\) 的等效值；稿件6.626这一数字不是P3原报值。
text.en: Differentiate \(eV_s=h\nu-\phi\) with respect to ν at fixed φ: first \(e\,dV_s/d\nu=h\), then divide by e to obtain h/e. The horizontal unit Hz is s^−1 and the vertical unit V, giving V·s=J·s/C. P3 explicitly states h/e, adopts approximately \(4.128\times10^{-15}\,\mathrm{V\,s}\), and reports an h equivalent to \(6.57\times10^{-34}\,\mathrm{J\,s}\); 6.626 is not P3’s reported number.

title.zh: 电子衍射峰是否与加速电压无关
title.en: Are electron diffraction peaks independent of accelerating voltage?

summary.zh: P4直接记录峰随电压出现、移动并消失。
summary.en: P4 directly records peaks appearing, moving, and disappearing with voltage.

why.zh: 图9、10及p.717文字展示同一峰的连续电压变化。
why.en: Figures 9–10 and the text on p.717 show the same peak changing with voltage.

text.zh: 装置测量的是不同方向的收集电子电流。固定晶体条件下，原文同一峰在约40 V时位于60°附近，54 V时在50°最强，约66 V时在40°附近消失。改变加速电压V改变电子动量：非相对论条件下 \(p=\sqrt{2meV}\)。采用h/p波长后，V改变相位匹配方向就有可检验意义；观察结果与“固定几何、完全无关”相反。
text.en: The apparatus measures collected electron current in different directions. With the same crystal, one peak is near 60° at about 40 V, strongest at 50° and 54 V, and disappears near 40° at about 66 V. Changing accelerating voltage V changes electron momentum, \(p=\sqrt{2meV}\) in the nonrelativistic regime. With wavelength h/p, voltage-dependent phase-matching directions become testable; the observations contradict complete independence from voltage.

title.zh: 附上波长和振幅能否解释所有条纹
title.en: Does adding wavelength and amplitude explain every fringe?

summary.zh: h/p和振幅规则可构成波动解释的一部分，单独列出它们尚不能计算所有条纹。
summary.en: H/p and amplitude rules can be parts of a wave account, but listing them alone does not calculate every fringe.

why.zh: 还缺少振幅的动力学、晶格散射势、边界条件和计数模型；P4也保留未解释束。
why.en: Amplitude dynamics, a lattice-scattering potential, boundary conditions, and a counting model are still missing; P4 also retains unexplained beams.

text.zh: 波长决定相位随路径变化的尺度，但强度图还需要各路径的振幅与相位。\(|\psi|^2\) 只在ψ已经由完整模型确定时给出计数分布；任意指定ψ可以拟合许多图形，却不是从轨迹得到预测。P4明确采用波假设并检查晶格方向关系，同时记录未解释或未观察到的束。因此稿件的“所有条纹”需要实际可计算模型和逐项比较。
text.en: Wavelength determines how phase changes with path length, but an intensity pattern also needs amplitudes and phases for the paths. \(|\psi|^2\) supplies a counting distribution only after a complete model determines ψ; freely choosing ψ may fit many patterns without predicting them from trajectories. P4 explicitly uses a wave hypothesis and checks crystal-direction relations while retaining unexplained or unobserved beams. The manuscript’s “every fringe” therefore requires an actual calculable model and itemized comparison.

title.zh: 电磁干涉能否证明电子轨道完备
title.en: Does electromagnetic interference prove electron-trajectory completeness?

summary.zh: 经典电磁场能干涉，不能由此直接推出电子轨道的完整衍射解释。
summary.en: Interference of classical electromagnetic fields does not directly establish a complete diffraction account for electron trajectories.

why.zh: 两种现象测量的对象不同，形式相似不能代替电子模型中的连接规则。
why.en: The observables differ; formal similarity cannot replace connecting rules in the electron model.

text.zh: 光的干涉从电场叠加及能流的平方读数得到；电子实验测的是不同方向到达收集器的电子电流。若要把电场的数学形式用于电子，必须说明电子的波是什么、如何传播、怎样决定计数。P4用h/p波长与相位叠加作这个解释连接。只援引经典光的干涉，尚未为原稿规定的粒子轨迹提供这些关系。
text.en: Optical interference follows from electric-field superposition and a squared energy-flow readout; the electron experiment measures current arriving at a collector from different directions. Applying the field mathematics to electrons requires identifying their wave, its propagation, and how it determines counts. P4 supplies an interpretive connection through h/p and phase superposition. Invoking classical optical interference alone does not provide those relations for the manuscript’s stipulated particle trajectories.

title.zh: 题名能否确认未附证明覆盖所有边界条件
title.en: Can a title verify all boundary conditions in an unprovided proof?

summary.zh: 题名只能确认书目条目，S3的证明内容目前无法核查。
summary.en: The title identifies a bibliographic entry; S3’s proof content cannot currently be examined.

why.zh: 提供材料只有metadata_only目录记录，正文路径为null。
why.en: The supplied material is a metadata_only catalogue entry with a null body-text path.

text.zh: 审查一个完备性定理需要知道研究对象、允许的状态、动力学、边界条件和实际推导。当前目录只有题名和年份，未附这些内容；顶层来源目录与附件清单也没有指向正文。因此“题名足以确认”是无依据的推断，而证明本身是否成立仍是访问缺口。下一步所需材料是可核读的S3正文及其明确假设。
text.en: Reviewing a completeness theorem requires its objects, allowed states, dynamics, boundary conditions, and actual derivation. The present catalogue gives a title and year without those contents, and neither the top-level catalogue nor the attachment inventory points to body text. Thus “the title alone confirms it” is unsupported, while the proof’s actual validity remains an access gap. Readable S3 text and explicit assumptions are the needed next material.

evidence.locator: §1, first sentence; §5, sentences 2–3

finding.zh: 稿件规定状态为连续位置、动量和电磁场，动力学为牛顿—麦克斯韦方程，并另取平衡能量均分；§5又引入波长、复振幅和计数概率。
finding.en: The manuscript defines continuous positions, momenta, and electromagnetic fields, Newton–Maxwell dynamics, and equilibrium equipartition; §5 additionally introduces wavelength, complex amplitude, and counting probability.

method.zh: 区分作者规定的模型与该模型是否解释实验；逐项比较§1和§5使用的对象。
method.en: Separate the stipulated model from its empirical adequacy and compare the objects used in §§1 and 5.

reason.zh: 停止于稿件明示的模型边界；定义本身不构成微观适用性的实验检验。
reason.en: Stops at the manuscript’s stated model boundary; a definition is not an experimental test of microscopic applicability.

finding.zh:
P2对一维谐振子使用连续能量分布 \(e^{-E/(k_BT)}\)，积分得到平均能量 \(k_BT\)。结合辐射模关系，式(6)得到 \(u_
u=8\pi

finding.en: Planck writes total energy as an integer number of finite equal elements, \(U_N=P\varepsilon\), and computes entropy using \(S_N=k\log W\) and an equal-probability allocation hypothesis. Page 556 explicitly distinguishes this from continuously, indefinitely divisible energy.

method.en: Compared extracted text with the p.556 scan to confirm discrete, finite elements and Eq.(4), then read the equal-probability statement.

method.zh: 跟读组合计数和熵表达式；仅以现代符号重写，保留大N、P近似。

method.zh: 用指数级数保留并检查被删项，再直接取两谱比值；此核查不依赖新实验。
method.en: Retained and checked omitted terms in the exponential series, then took the ratio of the spectra; no new experiment is involved.

reason.zh: 严格不等式已足以否定任意正x精确相等；近似的误差由显式余项和比值给出。

reason.zh: S1只给出六位小数导出值与打印表，原未舍入数组未提供；可复核其恒等式来源，无法把末位打印精度解释为测量不确定度。

reason.en: Reached the authors’ published curves, Table II, and procedure. Laboratory notebooks and instrument files were not supplied; approximately 0.5% is the original precision estimate, not zero error.

method.zh: 目视核对式(1)与总结；将原文逸出功p改记φ，避免与稿件电子动量p混淆。
method.en: Visually checked Eq.(1) and the summary; renamed the original work term p as φ to avoid confusion with electron momentum p in the manuscript.

finding.en: Millikan objects to the then-current localized light-quantum/semi-corpuscular interpretation while explicitly acknowledging the photoelectric equation’s experimental success and discussing alternative mechanisms requiring additional assumptions. method.en: Read the intensity-control description alongside this paper’s frequency-scan curves; the retrospective description is not treated as a complete raw intensity-data table.

reason.zh: 足以判断P3所报告的依赖方向；该控制在此处为作者对早期实验的回顾，完整上游实验记录未取得。

evidence.locator: pp.380–383 §5–§6; pp.384–385 absorption-time discussion

reason.en: Reached the published cutoff test and timing argument; it concerns ordinary photoemission and controlled surfaces, not an exhaustive statement about strong-field, multiphoton, or thermal emission.

evidence.locator: Dimensional and historical-number check of manuscript §4

finding.zh: 对 \(eV_s=h\nu-\phi\) 在固定φ下微分，\(dV_s/d\nu=h/e\)，单位 \(\mathrm{V/Hz=V\,s=J\,s/C}\)。\(h\) 的单位为 \(\mathrm{J\,s}\)。P3的 \(6.57\times10^{-27}\,\mathrm{erg\,s}\) 换算为 \(6.57\times10^{-34}\,\mathrm{J\,s}\)，并非稿件的6.626值。
finding.en: Differentiating \(eV_s=h\nu-\phi\) at fixed φ gives \(dV_s/d\nu=h/e\), in \(\mathrm{V/Hz=V\,s=J\,s/C}\); h is in \(\mathrm{J\,s}\). P3’s \(6.57\times10^{-27}\,\mathrm{erg\,s}\) converts to \(6.57\times10^{-34}\,\mathrm{J\,s}\), not the manuscript’s 6.626 value.

method.zh: 使用电势能定义eV、Hz=s^−1、1 erg=10^−7 J，逐项检查等号两端量纲并核对历史报告值。
method.en: Used electric potential energy eV, Hz=s^−1, and 1 erg=10^−7 J to check dimensions and the historically reported value.

reason.zh: 电荷因子由电势与能量的定义必然出现；未将1916年h测定值更新成现代常数后再归给原作者。
reason.en: The charge factor follows necessarily from the definitions of potential and energy; the 1916 determination was not replaced by a modern constant and attributed to the original author.

evidence.locator: pp.707–708 apparatus; pp.715–718 Figs.9–12; PDF pp.3–4,11–14

finding.zh: 原文用可转动收集器测电子散射电流，同时扫描加速电压与方向。图10及p.717显示同一峰从约40 V时60°附近弱峰，发展为54 V时50°强峰，再在约66 V、40°附近消失。
finding.en: The paper measures electron-scattering current with a movable collector while scanning accelerating voltage and direction. Figure 10 and p.717 show one feature developing from a weak peak near 60° at about 40 V to a strong peak at 50° and 54 V, then disappearing near 40° at about 66 V.

method.zh: 对照图9、10扫描图和紧邻文字；角度采用原文相对反向入射轴的colatitude，不将其直接混同Bragg掠射角。
method.en: Compared the scans of Figs.9–10 with adjacent text; used the paper’s colatitude from the reversed incident-beam axis, not a Bragg glancing angle.

reason.zh: 原刊曲线及测量程序足以否定电压完全无关；未重新做实验或把峰位近似值当作无误差数据。
reason.en: The published curves and procedure suffice to reject complete voltage independence; no new experiment was performed and approximate peak positions are not error-free data.

evidence.locator: pp.721–725, interpretation opening, Table I and plane-grating discussion

finding.zh: 原文主动采用电子束等效于波长 \(h/mv\) 的辐射这一假设，并通过晶格散射的相位重合解释强束。表I按 \(\lambda(\text{Å})\simeq\sqrt{150/V}\) 由电压算等效波长；54 V对应约1.67 Å。
finding.en: The paper explicitly adopts the hypothesis that the electron beam is equivalent to radiation of wavelength \(h/mv\), explaining strong beams by phase coincidence in lattice scattering. Table I computes equivalent wavelengths from voltage using \(\lambda(\text{Å})\simeq\sqrt{150/V}\); 54 V corresponds to about 1.67 Å.

method.zh: 区分直接测得的电压、方向和电流，与基于h/p换算的表I波长列；追读表II对波长—角度关系的检查。
method.en: Distinguished measured voltage, angle, and current from Table I’s wavelengths calculated using h/p, and read Table II’s check of the wavelength–angle relation.

reason.zh: h/p和相位叠加在P4中作为解释假设引入；表I派生波长不是另一组独立波长测量。
reason.en: P4 introduces h/p and phase superposition as interpretive assumptions; Table I’s derived wavelengths are not a separate set of independent wavelength measurements.

evidence.locator: p.705 abstract; p.725 following Table II

finding.zh: P4摘要记载30组电子束，其中6组与吸附气体有关；气体清除后24组中20组对应Laue束，3组作单层衍射解释，1组低强度束未解释，另有8组预期弱束未检出。p.725还说明某些预期二阶束缺失。
finding.en: P4’s abstract records 30 beam sets, six associated with adsorbed gas; among 24 sets from the gas-free crystal, 20 are correlated with Laue beams, three receive a single-layer diffraction interpretation, and one weak set is unexplained, with eight expected weak sets unobserved. Page 725 also notes missing expected second-order beams.

method.zh: 读取作者对已解释、未解释和未观察束的分别登记，保留原实验的非完备部分。
method.en: Read the separate accounting of explained, unexplained, and unobserved beams, retaining the experiment’s incomplete parts.

reason.zh: 停止于作者对实验覆盖和解释范围的记录；这些限制与清楚的电压依赖并存，不可据其任一方推出全部条纹无误差。
reason.en: Stops at the authors’ account of experimental coverage and interpretation; these limits coexist with clear voltage dependence and do not establish error-free explanation of all fringes.

evidence.locator: Logical comparison of manuscript §1 model with §5 added objects

finding.zh: \(m\ddot{\mathbf r}=\mathbf F\) 给出指定力和初值下的轨迹，未规定任意复函数ψ、其演化、相位、归一化或探测概率。再规定 \(\lambda=h/p\) 和 \(\rho=|\psi|^2\) 会增加模型关系；仅写出这些关系仍缺少计算完整条纹所需的势场、边界条件、入射态和探测规则。
finding.en: \(m\ddot{\mathbf r}=\mathbf F\) specifies trajectories given forces and initial data; it does not specify a complex function ψ, its evolution, phase, normalization, or detection probability. Imposing \(\lambda=h/p\) and \(\rho=|\psi|^2\) adds model relations; those relations alone still lack the potential, boundary conditions, incident state, and detection rule needed to calculate a full fringe pattern.

method.zh: 比较方程的未知量和所需输出：若同一轨迹可搭配多个不同ψ，牛顿方程本身便无法选定其计数图。
method.en: Compared the equations’ variables with their required outputs: if the same trajectory can accompany different ψ functions, Newton’s equation alone cannot select the counting pattern.

reason.zh: 稿件没有给出从既定变量到ψ及其统计规则的推导，也没有可计算所有条纹的完整模型；需补齐这些内容才能评价扩展模型。
reason.en: The manuscript supplies no derivation from its stipulated variables to ψ and its statistics, nor a complete model calculating every fringe; these would be needed to assess an extended model.

evidence.locator: Maxwell linear-wave consequence, within the model stipulated in §1

finding.zh: 在真空等线性传播问题中，Maxwell方程允许 \(\mathbf E=\mathbf E_1+\mathbf E_2\)。强度含交叉项 \(|E_1+E_2|^2=|E_1|^2+|E_2|^2+2\operatorname{Re}(E_1^*E_2)\)，相干波相位使该项随位置变化；孔径边界下的传播可形成衍射。
finding.en: In linear propagation problems such as vacuum, Maxwell’s equations permit \(\mathbf E=\mathbf E_1+\mathbf E_2\). Intensity has the cross term \(|E_1+E_2|^2=|E_1|^2+|E_2|^2+2\operatorname{Re}(E_1^*E_2)\), which varies spatially with coherent phase; propagation with aperture boundaries can produce diffraction.

method.zh: 从稿件选定的Maxwell线性方程解释叠加和平方读数；把电场复表示同电子概率振幅区别。
method.en: Explained superposition and squared readout from the manuscript’s Maxwell equations, distinguishing a complex electric-field representation from an electron probability amplitude.

reason.zh: 本节点说明经典电磁场可以干涉和衍射；没有从电场干涉推导电子的概率律。
reason.en: This node explains interference and diffraction of classical electromagnetic fields; it does not derive electron probability laws from field interference.

finding.zh: 单位选择可改变h的数值表示，却不改变无量纲比 \(x=h\nu/(k_BT)\) 或 \(u_P/u_{RJ}=x/(e^x-1)\)。它也不把测得的 \(dV_s/d\nu=h/e\) 变成零或常量热容3R；电子波长关系把h连接到动量和晶格尺度。
finding.en: Choosing units can change h’s numerical representation but not dimensionless ratios such as \(x=h\nu/(k_BT)\) or \(u_P/u_{RJ}=x/(e^x-1)\). It also does not remove the measured \(dV_s/d\nu=h/e\) or turn the heat capacity into constant 3R; the electron wavelength relation connects h to momentum and lattice scale.

method.zh: 比较不依赖单位系统的谱比与可观察关系，避免把有量纲常数的表示自由等同于理论内容消失。
method.en: Compared unit-independent spectral ratios and observable relations, distinguishing freedom in representing a dimensional constant from elimination of theoretical content.

reason.zh: 这些具体差异足以否定本文“只是单位”的推论；未尝试以四篇历史论文证明全部量子理论。
reason.en: These concrete differences suffice to reject this manuscript’s “mere units” inference; the four historical papers are not used to prove all of quantum theory.

evidence.locator: Evidence synthesis for abstract and §6

finding.zh: 统一验证的四条支线分别出现模型依赖的恒等式处理、错误零温极限、光电文献结论反读和电子峰位的电压依赖；S3又仅有书目。已有证据支持若干受限经典极限，但无法推出原稿的无条件精确完备。
finding.en: The four purported verification branches instead contain a model-dependent processing identity, an incorrect zero-temperature limit, a reversed reading of the photoelectric paper, and voltage-dependent electron peak positions; S3 is only metadata. The evidence supports some restricted classical limits but not the manuscript’s unconditional exact completeness.

method.zh: 按每条支线的实际测量对象、前提和停止点评估其能否支撑总论断，不把多个引用数目相加当成独立验证。
method.en: Evaluated whether each branch’s actual observable, assumptions, and endpoint support the overall claim, without treating the number of citations as independent verification.
